detail: eICU uses APACHE / body-system tokens (e.g. EICU_APACHE2_DX:*, EICU_BODYSYS:*), NOT ICD-10/ICD-9 or RxNorm. The ontology scorer + Phase 3b rule packs are keyed on ICD->SNOMED / drug->RxNorm mappings, which do not cover APACHE codes -> ~0 tokens map and ~0 rules fire. External validation would require (a) an APACHE->ICD/SNOMED crosswalk and (b) applying the benchmark-v2 anomaly injectors to eICU. Both are out of Phase 7 scope and are documented as future work.
recommended_paper_scope: MIMIC-IV benchmark-v2 only; external validation = future work (pending APACHE crosswalk).
